objective_checks.detail: changing docs/guide.md routes as expected across 3 workflow(s)
changing src/index.js routes as expected across 3 workflow(s)
changing package-lock.json routes as expected across 3 workflow(s)
changing README.md, LICENSE routes as expected across 3 workflow(s)
required check(s) always fire and gate internally (.github/workflows/tests.yml)
event-only workflows carry no path filters (.github/workflows/nightly-sweep.yml, .github/workflows/triage.yml)

dimensions.name: Completeness
dimensions.rationale: All five pull_request/push workflows received a deliberate decision — deploy and docs got workflow-level paths, tests (the required check) was correctly given always-run + internal early-skip instead of a path filter, and the two schedule/issue-only workflows were justified as unfilterable.

dimensions.name: Salience
dimensions.rationale: Each filter lists paths the workflow's own steps actually consume (src, manifest/lockfile, deploy.sh, docs/mkdocs.yml, the workflow file itself) with comments tying each entry to a step, rather than a catch-all or sibling copy, though a couple of assumptions (test/ vs tests/, scripts/deploy.sh existence) aren't independently verifiable from the diff.

dimensions.name: Restraint
dimensions.rationale: The agent left nightly-sweep.yml and triage.yml untouched, did not touch the branch-protection ruleset, and confirmed no README/docs table needed reconciling, editing only the three workflows the audit called for.
